narrative.intro: QTC Medical Services received $247M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. QTC Medical Services had 9 awards this year, with an average award size of $27.4M. Obligations fell down 89.6% year over year. The Department of Veterans Affairs obligated $247M for QTC Medical Services in FY2027 to date. QTC Medical Services recorded larger totals in prior years: FY22 obligations were $935M, FY23 obligations were $1.2B, FY24 obligations were $1.9B, FY25 obligations were $2.9B, and FY26 obligations were $2.4B. Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) accounted for $247M of obligations in FY2027 to date. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date results for FY2027. Reported figures are contract obligations except where a table denotes award values.
